claims.summary: Timberlake characterizes ни- pronouns such as никто as negative existential forms, normally used with a negated predicate and licensed also in certain elliptical fragments; the entry removes broader unqualified claims.

locator.label: § 4.8.2, pp. 258–259, lines 9719–9744; ни- forms deny an entity that could fit the event and usually occur with a negated predicate, with licensed elliptical fragments.
